subject: Catalogly POC — post-call recap & proposed success criteria
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Anika Shah <anika@catalogly.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Catalogly POC — post-call recap & proposed success criteria

Anika — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment on scope before I share a formal SOW: 

Key discovery notes:
- Goal: reduce catalog ingestion & normalization time and enable chat-based support for merchants searching SKUs.
- Primary data: nightly catalog dumps (~1M SKUs), metadata fields (title, description, tags), and vendor mappings.
- Compliance: PII-only within product descriptions (no customer PII), Catalogly needs data residency in us-central.

Proposed POC (4 weeks) — high level
- Use cases:
  1) Intent routing + QA for catalog search suggestions (real-time)
  2) Batch catalog import normalization (sample of 50k rows, offline evaluation)
- Success criteria (pass = green):
  • Search suggestion precision @10 >= 0.78 on your 2k test set
  • Normalization F1 >= 0.82 on sampled supplier mappings
  • Avg inference latency for search suggestions <= 120ms (p50)

Owners & timeline (draft):
- Redwood: Priyom (lead), Ben (infra/eval), Aditya (security sign-off)
- Catalogly: Anika (product), engineering contact tbd
- Week 0–1: data access + sandbox setup
- Week 2: first eval run (search suggestions)
- Week 3: normalization batch run + metrics review
- Week 4: final demo + decision gate

I've attached a short draft POC doc (Catalogly_POC_draft.pdf) with more details. If this looks good, I can convert to an SOW and share acceptance gates + a proposed quote.

Open questions for you:
1) Can engineering provide a sample nightly dump by end of week (SFTP or S3 link)?
2) Do you want the batch normalization included in the initial POC, or staged as a follow-on?

Thanks — happy to jump on a short follow-up tomorrow to lock timeline.

--
Priyom Das
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
priom@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0131

From: Anika Shah <anika@catalogly.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Catalogly POC — post-call recap & proposed success criteria

Thanks Priyom — this is very helpful. Quick answers inline and a request: 

Inline:
- Engineering can provide S3 access to a 30-day sample by Friday (I will send creds to your security contact).
- We definitely want the batch normalization included in the initial POC — our biggest manual workload is supplier mapping.

Additional ask: can we add a "catalog import" use case focused on vendor-supplied CSVs with inconsistent headers? That would be an offline workflow but critical to our go/no-go. I attached a short spec with examples (catalog_import_spec.xlsx).

Timing constraints: we have an internal exec review on Nov 30 — it would be ideal to sign off the POC scope and acceptance criteria with you by Nov 9 so we can schedule the exec demo for the 30th. If you can accelerate the sandbox start by a few days that would help.

Happy to hop on another 30-minute call tomorrow afternoon if that helps.

Best,
Anika
Head of Product, Catalogly
anika@catalogly.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Catalogly POC — post-call recap & proposed success criteria

Priyom / team — thanks for the notes. I agree we should fold the catalog import use case into the baseline POC rather than treat it as a follow-on, but that changes the evaluation plan and a couple of owners. Proposed re-baseline below (I'm copying Aditya to confirm security timeline):

Re-baselined scope (4 weeks):
- Use cases: 1) Search suggestion precision (real-time) 2) Batch normalization (50k sample) 3) Catalog import CSV normalization (10 sample files)

Updated success criteria:
- Search suggestion precision @10 >= 0.78 on your 2k test set
- Normalization F1 >= 0.82 on supplier mapping sample
- CSV import struct-match rate >= 0.85 on the 10 sample files (field mapping correctness)
- Latency targets unchanged (p50 <= 120ms for suggestion path)

Operational changes & owners:
- Infra / sandbox: Ben (lead) — target sandbox by 2026-11-06 if we get S3 creds by 2026-11-03
- Eval harness & metrics: Marissa (lead) — will prepare the evaluation notebook and test harness; request Anika to share gold labels for normalization tasks
- Security & compliance sign-off: Aditya (lead) — estimated 3 business days after we have the S3 link and proof of encryption at rest

Decision gates and dates:
- 2026-11-03: finalize scope (this week)
- 2026-11-06: sandbox available (if creds arrive 11/03)
- 2026-11-13: first eval pass (search suggestions)
- 2026-11-20: batch runs complete + mid-poC review
- 2026-11-27: final metrics + exec materials ready

A couple of practical asks to keep the timeline: please get engineering to share the S3 link by EOD Tuesday (11/03) and include one small sample CSV with the worst-case header variability. Also request that Catalogly provide the gold labels for the 50k normalization sample by 11/10 so Marissa can run the F1 calculations on schedule.

I'll draft a short re-baseline note we can send to Anika once Priyom confirms.

-Ben

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-03T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Catalogly POC — confirmed re-baseline, owners, and next steps

Anika — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the sample spec. We agree to re-baseline and include the catalog-import CSV normalization in the initial POC. Below is the final scope and clear next steps so we can meet your internal Nov 30 exec date.

Finalized scope (4-week timeline):
- Use cases: search suggestions (real-time), supplier normalization (batch), CSV import normalization (offline)
- Acceptance gates: see below (metrics + dates)

Acceptance gates and owners:
- Gate 1 (sandbox provisioned) — 2026-11-06 (Ben lead) — success = sandbox with S3 access + sample CSV uploaded
- Gate 2 (first eval) — 2026-11-13 (Marissa lead) — success = search suggestion precision >= 0.78 on your test set
- Gate 3 (batch/CSV runs) — 2026-11-20 (Marissa/Ben lead) — success = normalization F1 >= 0.82, CSV struct-match >= 0.85
- Gate 4 (final review) — 2026-11-27 (Priyom lead) — success = ready exec pack for Nov 30 demo + decision: proceed to pilot or iterate

Action items (owner / due):
- Catalogly / Anika: share S3 link + creds + one worst-case CSV by EOD 2026-11-03 (Anika)
- Redwood / Ben: provision sandbox and confirm connectivity by 2026-11-06 (Ben)
- Catalogly: provide gold labels for 50k normalization sample by 2026-11-10 (Anika)
- Redwood / Marissa: prepare evaluation notebooks and dashboards; share initial template by 2026-11-09 (Marissa)

Links & docs:
- POC folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdEfGhIJkLMnoPQrsTUvX
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-8391

If this matches your expectations, I'll convert the POC doc to a short SOW and send across a quote and a DocuSign link for signature by 11/06.

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly.
